faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Hyderabad Library Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the IIIT Hyderabad Library Assistant position is 25 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Library Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Masters in Library & Information Sciences from a nationally important institute with a flair for technology. A PG Diploma in Library Automation & Networking or PGDCA is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Library Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Library Assistant post at IIIT Hyderabad.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to send their detailed resume to the specified email address.

faq.answer: The job type for the Library Assistant position is Contract.

faq.answer: The salary will be commensurate with experience as per the Institute's pay scale.
